params.name: q
params.description:
Filter audit logs by field values. Use the format `column_name:value1,value2` to match entries where the column contains any of the specified values.

You can pass multiple `q` parameters to build complex filters. They are combined using the `search_operator` parameter.

params.name: search_operator
params.description:
The logical operator used to combine multiple `q` filters.

Use `or` to return logs matching any filter. Use `and` to return only logs matching all filters.

params.name: sort
params.description:
Sort the results by one or more columns. Use the format `column_name` for ascending order or `-column_name` for descending order.

For example, `-occurred_at` sorts by most recent first.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of audit log entries to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of entries to skip before returning results. Use with `limit` to paginate through large result sets.

params.name: from_date
params.description: Only return audit logs that occurred on or after this timestamp. Use ISO 8601 format with timezone.

params.name: to_date
params.description: Only return audit logs that occurred on or before this timestamp. Use ISO 8601 format with timezone.

items.docs: Retrieve audit logs for your organization with support for search, sorting, pagination, and date filtering.
